description: Open-source batch OCR workbench — a free, local alternative to ABBYY FineReader. Powered by Ollama + GLM-OCR + PP-DocLayoutV3, ~0.5s/page on RTX 4090. Three-panel editor, layout-aware, PDF/image batch processing, Markdown/Word export. 批量OCR工作台，纯本地运行，免费平替ABBYY，适合书籍文档数字化。
